entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: A heretical vampire hierophant of the Church of Dusk who worshipped Aclazotz and was granted demonic power.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Ancient bat god bound in the Core of Ixalan whom Vito freed.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire church to which Vito belonged.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: Vampire saint who returned with news of the Sun's disappearance.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact in which Vito believed salvation lay.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: Led a splinter group of the church.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Planar traveler who joined the party.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Core civilization who imprisoned the vampires.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: Inner sun of the Core attacked by Aclazotz.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Former planeswalker who killed Vito with Tarrian's lance.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin, killed by Vito's followers.

entities.name: Venerable Tarrian
entities.description: Owner of the lance and journal Vito carried.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Vito began his fast.

events.summary: Vito, shocked by Elenda's news, overturns a carafe of blood in defiance.
events.quote: he overturned a massive carafe of blood onto the church's floor.

events.summary: During a blood fast Vito receives visions from Aclazotz.
events.quote: Vito heard whispers and received visions from Aclazotz

events.summary: Vito supports Vona de Iedo's schism and leads an expedition to Ixalan.
Vito uses a blood sacrifice to open the Temple of Aclazotz to the inner caverns.
events.quote: used a blood sacrifice to gain access to Ixalan's inner caverns.

events.summary: Kellan joins the party despite Vito's displeasure.
events.quote: the planar traveler Kellan joined the party

events.summary: The Oltec imprison the vampires; Vito engineers a violent escape.
Vito feeds kidnapped Oltec to Aclazotz, who breaks free and turns Vito and followers into demons.
events.quote: he fed these people to the ancient god, who broke his bindings.

events.summary: Vito's followers rampage into the Oltec city and kill Inti.
Huatli kills Vito with Tarrian's lance.

relations.quote: who worshipped Aclazotz on the plane of Ixalan
a heretical vampire hierophant of the Church of Dusk
summoning a horde of dinosaurs and killing him with Tarrian's lance
